kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَيَوَان • (ḥayawān) m (plural حَيَوَانَات (ḥayawānāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Inherited from Proto-West Semitic *ḥayaw- (“animal”). Cognate with Hebrew חיה (ḥayyā), Classical Syriac ܚܝܘܬܐ (ḥaywəṯā) and Ugaritic 𐎈𐎆𐎉 (ḥwṭ). Synchronically, a verbal noun of حَيَّ (ḥayya, “to live”).
g: verbal noun of حَيَّ (ḥayya): life; (especially) long, eternal life
